title: Declare and enforce the supported Rust MSRV
description:
The workspace has no declared or tested Rust support policy: manifests omit `rust-version` and CI follows moving `stable`.

Source: `Cargo.toml:1-25`; `crates/jit/Cargo.toml:1-59`; `.github/workflows/ci.yml:43-46`; `dev/active/36d5451e-audit-notes.md:66-79,126-134`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The project declares one authoritative Rust support policy: a numeric MSRV or an explicitly enforced stable-only policy.
- [hard] REQ-02: Cargo metadata and CI enforce the selected policy.
- [hard] REQ-03: Installation and development documentation derives its Rust requirement from that policy.
